semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor materials and technologies essential for various semiconductor processes.
summary: Zhejiang LiuFang Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the development of new materials for the semiconductor industry, particularly in CVD SiC coating technology. Established in 2018, the company produces components and consumables for critical semiconductor processes including crystal growth, epitaxy, and etching.
capabilities: Consumables for epitaxy and etching processes
